"Repent, the Kingdom is near."

choices.feedback: [TODO:fr] He speaks the word of God.

turn_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] Your hour begins here.
The Father has called you.

Walk among them.

approach.title: [TODO:fr] Toward John
approach.text:
[TODO:fr] John stands in the river.
His eyes find yours.

demand_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] Be Humble
demand_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] You did not come to be honored.
You came to obey.

wait_consequence.title: [TODO:fr] The Hour Has Come
wait_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] The Father waits for this moment.
Go to John.

hesitate.text:
[TODO:fr] John whispers:
"I should be baptized by You."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

rebuke_consequence.text:

Answer him with peace.

choices.text: [TODO:fr] "Let it be so to fulfill all."

baptism.text:
[TODO:fr] The cool river rises.

resist_consequence.text:
[TODO:fr] This is the will of the Father.
Yield to the moment.
